townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Point to all three players marked *KNOW*.
townsfolk.flavor: Sarcasm is indeed the lowest form of wit. But speaking in response to your criticism, Sir, it is, nevertheless, a form of wit.
townsfolk.summary: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.
townsfolk.flavor: Certainly madam, under normal circumstances, you may borrow the Codex Malificarium from the library vaults. However, you do not seem to be a member.
townsfolk.summary: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise around the circle.
townsfolk.flavor: これは夢。それも夢。すべて夢です。
townsfolk.summary: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.

townsfolk.flavor: There is life behind the personality that uses personalities as masks. There are times when life puts off the mask and deep answers to deep.
townsfolk.summary: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.

townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Show a player with a different character type to previously.
townsfolk.flavor: More heat! Higher! Higher! Più alto! Ahhh... it is so beautiful from up here, don't you agree? Can you see the children fishing by the river, under the willow? Can you see the  glint of the sun on the circus tent-poles? What's this? An old man, alone, passed out in the vineyard? Less heat! Lower! Lower! Vai più in basso!
townsfolk.summary: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Choose a Village Idiot to be drunk. Wake the Village Idiots one at a time, they choose a player, show either good or evil thumbs according to the alignment of that player.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time, they choose a player, show either good or evil thumbs according to the alignment of that player.
townsfolk.flavor: Roses are blue, and violets are red, Please reverse what I just said.
townsfolk.summary: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
townsfolk.flavor: I sense great evil in your soul! But... that could just be your perfume. I am allergic to Elderberry.
townsfolk.summary: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.

townsfolk.flavor: 'Tis an ill and deathly wind that blows tonight. Come, my brother, take shelter in the abbey while the storm rages. By my word, or by my life, you will be safe.
townsfolk.summary: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

townsfolk.flavor: Only the chosen may gaze beyond the veil. The dead are restless, and they point in silence toward the icy north.
townsfolk.summary: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.

townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head.
townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head.
townsfolk.flavor: Did you hear that stranger in the cashmere coat put the word on our young Belle? And she said yes? Well, that's nothing compared to what Harry and that juggler got up to at the fair! The things I could say if I was a tattletale... my, yes.
townsfolk.summary: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.

townsfolk.flavor: I am here because of you, and you are here because of me.
townsfolk.summary: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.

townsfolk.otherNightReminder: If the Banshee was killed by the Demon tonight, announce to all players that the Banshee has died.
townsfolk.flavor: Gorm do shúile, dearg do ghruaig, ní bheidh sé i bhfad, is a mbeidh tú san uaigh.
townsfolk.summary: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.

townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Wake the Cannibal and treat them like they have the ability of the most recently killed executee.
townsfolk.flavor: I don’t like clowns. They taste funny.

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.
If the Cannibal gains the Zealot ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Cannibal eats the Poppy Grower, then dies or loses the Poppy Grower ability, the Demon and Minions learn each other that night.

townsfolk.summary: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.

minion.firstNightReminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character.  Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
minion.otherNightReminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character.  Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
minion.flavor: Reality is merely an opinion. Specifically, my opinion.

jinxes.reason: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.

minion.summary: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.

minion.flavor: Add compound Alpha to compound Beta... NOT TOO MUCH!
minion.summary: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.

minion.firstNightReminder: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.
minion.otherNightReminder: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.
minion.summary: You may choose to open your eyes at night. You wake when other evil players do.

minion.firstNightReminder: Run the Wizard's ability, if applicable.
minion.otherNightReminder: Run the Wizard's ability, if applicable.
minion.flavor: Every man and every woman is a star. Love is the law, love under will.
minion.summary: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.

minion.flavor: Three drops of goat's blood. A lock of hair, torn in anger. The name is spoken, the shadow cast. Walk left foot first down that brambled path, and don't look back.
minion.summary: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.

outsider.summary: You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]
outsider.flavor: In the lost and forgotten places of the earth, the soul’s light beckons.
I am not a freak! I am a human being! Have mercy!
outsider.summary: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.

outsider.flavor: I enjoy talking to you. Your mind appeals to me. It resembles my own mind except that you happen to be insane.
outsider.summary: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.

outsider.flavor: When one begins to think that some thing is merely some other thing, one is usually on the brink of an error. Patience, patience. Don’t confuse just and should with is and isn’t.
outsider.summary: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.

demon.firstNightReminder: Replace neighbors of the Lord of Typhon with Minions, wake them, tell them their new alignment and character, then do minion info.
demon.otherNightReminder: The Lord of Typhon chooses a player.
demon.flavor: In the shadowed and forgotten corners of the cosmos, where the stars whisper secrets to the void, lies a truth so profound that the merest glimpse of it unravels the sanity of mortal minds.
demon.summary: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]

demon.otherNightReminder: The Fang Gu chooses a player.  If they chose an Outsider (once only): Replace the Outsider token with the spare Fang Gu token. Put the Fang Gu to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Fang Gu tokens & give a thumbs-down.
demon.flavor: Your walls and your weapons are but smoke in dreams.
demon.summary: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]

demon.otherNightReminder: The Vigormortis chooses a player.  If that player is a Minion, poison a neighboring Townsfolk.
demon.flavor: All doors are one door. All keys are one key. All cups are one cup, but whosoever drinketh of the water that I give shall never thirst, but the water shall be in him a well springing up into everlasting life.
demon.summary: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
